name: Doling Justice
summary: With the sprite darters freed, Jer'kai Moonweaver and Kindal mean to take the fight to the Grimtotem clan. Jer'kai asks you to cut down Grimtotem Naturalists, Raiders and Shamans, then return to Jer'kai. This follows Freedom for All Creatures.

sections.title: Taking the Fight to the Grimtotem
sections.body: After Freedom for All Creatures, Jer'kai Moonweaver tells you that Kindal and Jer'kai will now strike back at the Grimtotem. Together they can thin out some of the tauren without much risk to themselves, but they would welcome your help. You have seen the camp below, and there are more to the east. Use your own tactics against Grimtotem Naturalists, Raiders and Shamans, then meet back where Jer'kai waits.

faq.answer: Jer'kai Moonweaver, in Feralas, once Kindal has told you what the pair intend after the sprite darter rescue.
Grimtotem Naturalists, Grimtotem Raiders and Grimtotem Shamans, among the tauren of the Grimtotem clan.
One camp lies in sight below Jer'kai, and Jer'kai says there are more to the east.
Freedom for All Creatures, in which you freed the sprite darters from the Grimtotem camp.
